args.name: Emergency opportunistic food foraging
args.function: Search for reachable food across resource types using actual observations and personally supported food-safety evidence; collect and immediately eat suitable food before continuing, rather than searching only for one named resource.
args.conditions: At tick 161 I have health 92, satiety 0, energy about 9.89, and no inventory. Starvation has caused damage. My last bounded berry search collected nothing. All currently visible food plants have zero stock. Berries are personally recorded as nutritious and nontoxic; other foods require supported safety evidence. No food availability is assumed.
args.inputs: A bounded search area, time and energy limits, an eating-energy reserve, health and temperature stops, and personal food evidence. Prefer reachable ripe sources; allow limited exploration only when feasible.
args.costs: Unknown implementation method. Actual travel, observation, gathering and eating must retain their real costs. Learning may take time. Do not create food, reveal hidden supplies, waive costs or restore health by declaration.
args.effects: Provide a feasible survival-oriented search and immediate-eating routine across supported edible resources, reporting unresolved food safety and stopping honestly when no reachable food is found. Starvation alone should not prevent a bounded attempt to obtain food; preserve enough energy to eat. No guaranteed discovery or healing.

candidates.function: Judge whether an item or source within reach is suitable food for you or a person you see, from probe evidence and your own cited records: identity, nutrition, toxicity and preparation each supported, contradicted or unresolved. inspect observes it with probe; trial runs probe press, wet or heat on your own sample. Nothing is tasted, eaten or fed.
candidates.costs: Study 1 round, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe observe, 1 round, 0.2 energy, no material. trial (methodRef press, wet or heat; intensity is the press load): probe's trial, 1 round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 unit of your own sample, consumed as loss; heat also takes 0.1 available heat from a source in reach, wet needs water where you stand. A trial needs a cited verified probe record of the same kind, method and load to compare with, since a load, water or heat response measures no nutrition, harm or preparation; otherwise it is refused, naming what is missing. Refusals cost nothing: target not seen now (only remembered or named), out of reach, another person's item, not a material, consumer not you or a person you see, unknown record ids. No surcharge, no refund.
candidates.effects: target: exact id of your item, a loose item or a source in reach. evidenceRefs: up to 6 ids of your records (record key or its evidence id, an eating record by its kind, a heard message id). intendedConsumer: you by default or a person you see; only your own records are used. Identity is supported only by your own eating record of the same kind, never by a name or label; only then are its satiety and health loss cited, and preparation is none for units as you ate them. A trial response that differs from the reference contradicts identity; a match identifies nothing. Without applicable evidence: "safety unresolved; do not consume on this evidence." An event and your record <target>:food-suitability keep the findings, evidence and limits. Nothing is gathered, moved, created, detoxified, certified or rewarded.

candidates.function: bounded-resource-search plus options: recheck sources last seen empty, an emergency mode for low satiety, stricter health and temperature stops, avoided areas or directions.
candidates.costs: None of its own: each round is one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and load, at most 0.8 per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the reserve; one that does not fit is not taken. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: the inputs of bounded-resource-search; without options it works exactly as that search (ripe sources seen now or remembered inside the radius, nearest reach first; walk, probe, gather; else walk to observed dry ground to see unseen parts). recheck: then sources last seen empty, seen now or in your own memory; a remembered one is only a navigate destination, its stock is learned by probe in reach; each is inspected at most once per run. emergency: satiety <= 8 alone does not stop it; health <= 60, an injury in the last round, body temperature 10 from 22 and every limit still do; minHealth, minTemp, maxTemp stop it sooner. avoidAreas (x, y, radius) and avoidDirections (from the origin): sources and ground there are left out and no step enters them. With recheck or emergency a food search needs reserve >= 1 (eat's energy). Another action pauses it; resume rechecks; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.function: bounded-resource-search-recheck plus lowHealth: a bounded search while health is low that stops at a health threshold you set (20 or more) instead of 60.
candidates.costs: None of its own: each round is one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and load, at most 0.8 per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the reserve; one that does not fit is not taken. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: Without lowHealth: exactly bounded-resource-search-recheck (minHealth 60 to 100). lowHealth: true: health at or below minHealth (default 20, 20 to 100) stops it instead of health 60, and satiety <= 8 or starvation damage alone does not; any other injury in the last round, body temperature 12 or below or 32 or above, minTemp, maxTemp, the reserve and every limit still do. radius, path, time, energy and quantity must be above 0. A food search needs reserve >= 1 and your own eating record of that food as edible and nontoxic. Ripe sources seen now or remembered in the radius first, nearest first; with recheck, then sources last seen empty, each probed at most once per run; a remembered place is only a navigate destination. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created, eaten or healed; no reward; food is not assured.

candidates.function: Inspect an established rooted food plant in reach and its growth needs, and loosen soil or clear competing plants by hand only where the growth model has crust, compaction or competition that limits it.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds, no energy; needs probe. inspect: probe's observation of the plant, 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare (hand loosening where modeled crust or compaction limits the plant, clearing where modeled competition does) would take 3 rounds at 2 energy each and maintain 1 round at 1 energy; this world's soil and plant model has neither condition, so both take 1 round, 0 energy, and change nothing. cancel: 1 round, 0 energy. Refusals cost nothing: target not in view or reach, or not an established rooted food plant that regrows (fungi, fish, seedlings, non-food and non-regrowing plants).
candidates.effects: target: a plant you see. inspect: probe's record (stock, growth, stage, soil) and the plant's growth contract from the existing rule: growth per ripe unit, growth so far, the least rounds to the next unit at the best rate (growth scale x full daylight), the temperature range (none at minGrowth, full at optimalGrowth), moisture need, waterlogging, harvest pressure 1/(1+depletion/20) and what limits it now. The first inspection records a baseline in your patch record (one square unit around the plant, at most 8 records); later ones report the change. prepare/maintain: 'no corrective work indicated', with the reason; quantity (rounds of work) stays unused. cancel: close the record for target, or all without one. Growth runs only through the existing rule, tended or not; harvest only with gather. No water is carried. Nothing is moved, created, refunded or rewarded.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

candidates.function: Collect exposed ripe food or loose material from a nearby natural source.
candidates.costs: 2 energy per unit, finite current source stock.
candidates.effects: Transfers real source stock to inventory; requires the source interaction range. No processing or felling is implied.

candidates.function: Search an area around an origin for sources of one known resource and collect up to a quantity, one navigate, probe or gather step per round, within path, time and energy limits.
candidates.costs: No cost of its own: each round runs one ordinary step at its own cost. navigate: actual distance x 2 energy, raised by ground and carried mass, at most 0.8 distance per round; probe observe: 1 round, 0.2 energy; gather: 1 round, 2 energy per unit. Each step is priced first against the path, time and energy left and the energy reserve; a step that does not fit is not taken and the search stops. time counts every round since start, paused ones too. Study: 1 round; needs navigate, probe and gather.
candidates.effects: start: resource, radius around x, y (default your position), path, time, energy, reserve, quantity. Candidates: sources of that resource you see now, or remember out of view, inside the radius, with ripe stock; nearest reach first; sources made by another person are left alone. It walks to one with navigate, inspects it with probe, then gathers min(stock, quantity left, units the energy allows). Sources seen empty are noted, not visited. If none is known it may walk to observed dry ground inside the radius to see its unseen parts; one known but beyond the limits stops it. It completes at the quantity or when nothing is left (perhaps with 0), and stops at a limit, health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 from 22 or an injury in the last round. Another action pauses it; resume rechecks all; cancel or death ends it. Nothing is refunded, created or eaten; no reward.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
candidates.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
candidates.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The related-capability searches and supplied contracts identify reusable bounded-search, safety-assessment, gathering and eating mechanisms, but not an equivalent integrated operation. bounded-resource-search-low-health searches for one resource and explicitly never eats; assess-food-suitability assesses evidence without gathering or consuming. Develop only the missing multi-resource selection and gather-then-eat orchestration in the current-conversation handoff, reusing those implementations rather than reinventing their effects. The current facts support berries as food, not the other named plants. No reachable food or successful outcome is established.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: bounded food foraging, parameterized for any applicable actor by origin, radius, maximum path length, elapsed-round limit, energy-spend limit, quantity/meal cap, eating reserve, personal evidenceRefs, recheck/exploration options, avoided areas/directions, and health/temperature stops. This is a serial controller, not a new food source or a safety oracle. Record implementation dependencies and code reuse explicitly: bounded-resource-search-low-health, bounded-resource-search-recheck, bounded-resource-search, assess-food-suitability, navigate, probe, gather and eat. Reuse the safety evidence evaluator internally; any separately executed assessment must retain its existing learning requirement. Do not grant those learned interfaces or individual mastery through registration. Any unavailable internal dependency or incompatible schema is an implementation task in this handoff, not grounds for permanent rejection.\\nPrerequisites: a living actor able to perform the underlying actions, applicable personal food evidence, and real reachable targets for any physical interaction. No tool or food is supplied. Accept exact personal record keys or evidence-event IDs; for Lin, the supplied personal record key berry supports the recorded nutrition 8 and toxicity 0 only to the extent allowed by the existing eating-evidence evaluator. The old commons-berry-1-0:observed-state record at tick 15 is a remembered destination/observation, not proof of present stock. Validate record type and applicability in code before consuming. Names, mature stage and visual labels alone establish neither identity nor safety. Root, hazelnut and acorn safety remain unresolved on these facts.\\nExecution: assemble eligible food kinds from applicable personal eating evidence, not a hidden global edible list. Consider actually observed or personally remembered sources inside the bounds; prefer currently observed ripe eligible sources, then bounded rechecks of remembered/observed empty sources if enabled. Use the inherited nearest-reach policy and real path feasibility across all eligible kinds rather than completing one resource search first. Recheck each empty source at most once per run. Remembered sources supply destinations only; probe in reach supplies current observations. Unknown observed food candidates may be reported as safety unresolved, never sampled by eating or presumed safe. Exploration is optional and limited to feasible observed traversable dry ground that can reveal new surroundings, without hidden-stock selection or entering avoided regions. Skip candidates whose verified action chain cannot fit the remaining budgets; stop when no feasible candidate or exploration step remains. All currently supplied visible food stocks are zero; branches and vines are not substitute food.\\nOn finding a currently supported ripe source, gather one supported edible unit, then make consuming that owned unit the next action before any further search or gathering. Revalidate safety, ownership and action feasibility at consumption. At most one ordinary primitive is scheduled per controller round, and its real duration is not shortened. An existing eligible owned unit may likewise be eaten first. Stop at the requested bounded intake/quantity cap or chosen satiety target; never force consumption after the actor stops. No automatic preparation, detoxification, gifting, participation by others or access to another actor's property is implied.\\nCosts and conservation: the controller adds no material or energy surcharge. Navigate costs actual distance times 2 energy, with existing ground/load modifiers and speed limit 0.8 per round; probe observation costs 1 round and 0.2 energy; gather costs 1 round and 2 energy per unit and subtracts exactly the transferred units from finite current source stock; eat costs 1 energy and consumes actual owned food under its existing nutrition/toxicity rules. Eating receives a serialized action slot and cannot be made instantaneous by this wrapper; retain any longer primitive duration. Assessment trials are unnecessary for the smallest version and are not run automatically. Study takes 1 round, zero added energy or material, with ordinary world physiology still applying. Review/development waiting advances no time. Before every step, quote its actual cost and reserve at least 1 energy for eating, or the larger actor-specified reserve; before gathering, budget the complete gather-and-eat pair. No credit for speculative food, future energy recovery or unperformed actions. Maintain separate gross energy spent, elapsed rounds, path traveled, gathered units and consumed nutrition. No free stock, healing, replenishment or canceled-action refund; actual toxicity remains possible if evidence proves imperfect. Basic nutrition follows eat, not mood.\\nEmergency behavior: inherit the low-health search rule so low satiety and starvation damage alone do not veto a bounded attempt. Use explicit minHealth in the existing range 20–100, default 60, and stop at or below it; stop for non-starvation injury in the preceding round, temperature at or below 12 or at or above 32, or stricter caller thresholds. Budget, reach, safety and reserve failures also stop. Lin's supplied health 92, energy 9.89056216 and temperature 28.5134988 do not alone bar an attempt, but do not establish an affordable route, food, or future survival. Evaluate actual vitals again after study and before every physical action.\\nProgress and lifecycle: keep one bounded run record with exact actor/target/source/item IDs, evidence references, current phase, visited sources, action outcomes, original start tick, limits and remaining budgets. Another action pauses the controller; resume rechecks life, safety, stock, ownership, position and budgets rather than replaying completed work. Elapsed time includes paused rounds as in the reused search engine. Cancel, death, exhausted limits or a hard stop ends scheduling immediately. Completed travel/observations remain real, gathered but uneaten food remains in actual inventory subject to ordinary ownership/death rules, and consumed food stays consumed. Refund no elapsed time, spent energy, used material or lost food; release only unspent reservations. There is no background searching, automatic resting, repeated regrowth polling or maintenance beyond action-time validation. Normal world growth and physiology continue only during actual advancing rounds. Completion reports consumed/gathered quantities, traveled distance, expenditure, observed stock, unresolved safety and the exact stopping reason, including an honest zero-food result. Implement established transitions and checks in code, not recurring model review.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"No pleasure or satisfaction is awarded for requesting, developing, naming, learning, starting, querying or finishing this controller. It has no new experience payout and cannot duplicate rewards of reused actions. Real eating retains existing nutrition and any independently established event-based experience rules, without mood-based nutrition reductions. A probe result, including verified zero stock, may constitute personally new information only if it creates an applicable evidence record; the request or an unverified guess does not. The smallest implementation records such information but adds no reward schedule. Any later experience implementation must separately define personally applicable verified events, functional deduplication, bounded amounts/caps and decay/cooldown before enabling rewards; familiar legitimate practice need not be novel to qualify under established rules. Physical comfort remains capped at 10. Protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse actual navigate, probe, gather and eat visual effects and associate them with their observable committed events. Add reusable controller metadata containing operation/run ID, actor ID, phase, target/source/item ID where known, action status, evidence-event references, measured quantity, elapsed work and stop reason. Distinguish searching, observing, gathering, eating, paused, stopped and canceled states. Mark a gathered unit only after a real stock-to-inventory transfer and an eaten unit only after consumption commits. Empty searches and unresolved food safety display neutral failure/unresolved indicators, never food-acquisition, safe-food, healing or meal-success effects. Coordinates and targets shown must come from authorized observations or personal memory and be labeled accordingly; visuals must not disclose hidden stock. No experience effect or functional benefit follows from displaying an animation.\"}]}"}
